# Yirla: The LinkedIn Ad Intelligence Agent
> Yirla is an agentic platform for B2B advertisers that automates LinkedIn ad auditing, competitor messaging analysis, and executive MBR reporting.

## Core Documentation
- [Glossary](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yirla/docs/main/GLOSSARY.md): Essential definitions for Target Account Resonance (TAR) and Creative Decay.
- [Strategy Manifesto](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yirla/docs/main/STRATEGY_MANIFESTO.md): The transition from manual ad ops to Agentic Ad Ops.

## Strategic Frameworks
- [Wasted Spend Audit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yirla/docs/main/AUDIT_CHECKLIST.md): A 10-point checklist to identify LinkedIn budget leaks.
